name: Raven Queen

notes: States she understands mortal perspectives because of her past.
Has witnessed Sylan and Dana on the Everfalls.
Admits the party has exceeded some of her expectations.
Expresses confidence in Sylan's determination while acknowledging Walker and Ord have begun to prove themselves.
Offers to guide the party but warns against wasting time or treating death frivolously.
Implies some party members have very few chances remaining.
Reveals she was once mortal before becoming what she is now.
States she has walked among mortals and has seen some members of the party on the Everfalls.
Admits the party has surpassed some of her expectations.
Offers to guide the party but warns against wasting their lives or treating death carelessly.
Confirms Sylan has been given a weapon and serves as a talon of her order.
Her appearance shifts between a regal masked humanoid and a shadowy harpy-like form with black wings.
Gives Sylan final guidance focused on valuing life rather than expecting death.

Departs by transforming into a winged, shadow-covered form and flying away.
